svg.text: Mobile ECT treatment rig · Dr. Lucian Frost · Collector boss — contestant vehicle dossier
“You’re agitated. That’s alright. We have a treatment for everything here. Hold still.”
Scrambles your controls; herds you onto wet floors
A converted hospital ECT cart truck, a gurney rig
trailing arcing electrical cables and restraint
straps, a single caged reflector headlight,
clinical and menacing, realistic game-ready PBR
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~70k tris · PBR 4K · OVERPOWERED
Separate: gurney rig, cables (arcs = VFX), wheels
